global_issues.title: Fed raises rates first time since 2023, hawkish on inflation
global_issues.note: Confirmed: FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on 2026-09-16, first hike since 2023, Chair Kevin Warsh cited persistent inflation. Markets initially fell on 9/16 then futures/stocks rebounded on 9/17 as briefing states. (CNBC, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance)

global_issues.title: Oil falls over 3% as Middle East supply fears ease
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Brent fell toward $102-105/bbl after Saudi Arabia said it could restore pipeline capacity and rerouted exports via Hormuz/Oman transfers, easing supply fears from the Iran conflict. (Reuters/Arab News, CNBC, Breakwave Advisors)
